services.story: The main story: a kids' room at Alex's family party, 2 teachers for 4 hours at $40 an hour each: $320. A card is saved for the $80 late-cancel or no-show fee, and it's charged for the hours given when the party is done.

services.story: A kids' room for a workplace that pays by bill: $320, nothing taken. Rosie texts the bill after the event.

services_shape: class: a place in an age room, by age, with a set room size and a child-to-teacher limit for each age, a start date and a schedule (full-time or part-time); a free tour with the director first; a waitlist in date order when a room is full; a drop-in or backup-care day for a child whose forms are on file. Away from the center: a kids' room run by two teachers at a family's event or a workplace, booked whole by the host
questions_before_times: a tour, a place or a drop-in day
the child's age in months or years (sets the room), from the parent's words; the AI passes only the age
full-time or part-time, and the start date wanted
away: a family event or a workplace, the date and hours, and how many children with their ages
safety_stop: a child hurt, missing or in danger right now
a report of abuse or neglect of a child, at the center or anywhere
license: from the state's form: a child care center license where the state's rules require one (most states license centers that care for children for pay); care away from the center (a kids' room at an event or a workplace) and babysitting need a license only where the state's form says so
staff_skills: infant care, toddlers and twos, preschool, event care
messages_never: a child's health, allergies, medicines, shot records, custody orders, who may and may not pick up, incidents and behavior never go in a text or through the AI; only the child's age passes through the AI, to set the room; texts to the owner or staff carry none of these and no age, only the parent's first name and last initial, the room and a link to the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
